evidence_summary: Official repository instructs downloading all TCGA WSIs for pretraining and reports approximately 15 million images from TCGA and PAIP.
Official repository instructs downloading all PAIP WSIs for pretraining.
Official developer description states that pretraining data were derived from TCGA.
Official model card identifies TCGA as a PANCAN-XL component.
Official model card identifies CPTAC as a PANCAN-XL component.
Official model card identifies GTEx as a PANCAN-XL component.
Official model card identifies TCIA among PANCAN-XL sources.
Primary paper describes UNI pretraining on Mass-100K.
Primary paper describes GTEx as a component of the pretraining corpus.
Primary paper describes visual pretraining on 335645 WSIs in Mass-340K.
Primary paper identifies GTEx as a component of Mass-340K.
Primary paper describes pretraining on more than 170000 Providence whole slides and more than one billion tiles.
Primary paper describes pretraining on 1.5 million MSKCC whole slide images.
Official model card states pretraining on 3.1 million MSKCC whole slide images.
Official model card describes a proprietary collection of more than 500000 H&E whole slide images without dataset identifiers.
Official repository states that the released hierarchical encoders were pretrained on TCGA whole-slide image patches and regions.
Official repository states that the released ViT-S SSL weights were pretrained on 19 million patches using TCGA.
Official model card states that H0-mini was distilled on 43 million tiles from 6093 TCGA slides and publishes tile coordinates.
